translations.web: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.
translations.bsb: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD, the guards would go with him, bearing the shields, and later they would return them to the guardroom.
translations.kjv: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
translations.asv: And it was so, that, as oft as the king entered into the house of Jehovah, the guard came and bare them, and brought them back into the guard-chamber.
